_guide: Things you can do when you Stay here on a world, and the lines that tell how it went.
activities: one entry each. id (lowercase, never reused), ic (an emoji), name, desc (one line for the Stay menu),
find: the chance (0 to 1) that the session turns up a new place on the world,
souvenir: the chance it brings back a collectible,
when (optional): only offered when the world matches, written like line conditions. ground: true / false, water, temp, life go from 0 to 1.
Its story lines go in the group called act_<id> below, written like content/lines.json. {crew} is whoever went, {place} a spot on the world
(one you found, or the world's name), plus {biome}, {weather}, {time}, {world}. Try them in tools/text-preview.html.
Biomes are often plural ("rust plains"), so don't put a verb or "a" straight after {biome}: write "the ground of the {biome} dips", not "the {biome} dips".

activities.name: Wander
activities.desc: Walk somewhere nobody has been and see what's there.

activities.name: Drift
activities.desc: Let the ship drift through the clouds and see where it ends up.

activities.name: Camp
activities.desc: Set up camp, light a fire, stay up too late.

activities.name: Stargaze
activities.desc: Find a quiet spot and look up for a while.

activities.name: Fish
activities.desc: Cast a line into whatever this world has instead of water.

activities.name: Sketch
activities.desc: Draw the view, slowly, until you really see it.

activities.name: Collect samples
activities.desc: Fill a few jars with rocks, air, dirt or something stranger.

activities.name: Cook
activities.desc: Make something with what grows, swims or crawls here.

activities.name: Crew picnic
activities.desc: Everybody outside, one big blanket, too much food.

place: A [quiet|wide|narrow|hidden] stretch of {biome}, [half in shadow|bright with {star} light|cut through by old tracks].
Here the ground of the {biome} [dips|rises|folds] into something that looks almost built on purpose.
[Wind|Silence|A low hum] fills this part of the {biome}. Nothing else seems to move.
A place where the edge of the {biome} meets something stranger, and neither seems sure who was here first.
[Rocks|Spires|Dunes|Ridges] in the {biome}, worn smooth by a very long time.

place.text: Pools of still water lie here, mirroring the sky [perfectly|almost perfectly].
Frost [lace|feathers|ferns] covers everything here, even the shadows.
The ground here is warm to the touch, and smells faintly of [smoke|metal|sulfur].
Small living things [crowd|hum|glow] in every crack here.
Clouds [pile up|swirl|part] here like a slow staircase going nowhere.
A calm patch inside the storms, where the air goes [silver|pale gold|soft blue].

act_wander: {Crew} walks out across the {biome} with no plan at all, which turns out to be a good plan.
{Crew} follows a trail that might be animal tracks, might be wind, and might be nothing.
{Crew} climbs the nearest high point to see what's on the other side. More {biome}. And then, something else.

act_wander.text: {Crew} walks until the ship is a little dot, then turns around and walks back, slowly.
{Crew} insists on taking the long way. {Crew.they} {crew:is|are} right.

act_drift: The ship drifts for hours through layers of cloud. {Crew} keeps the window open and doesn't talk much.
{Crew} cuts the engines and lets the wind take the ship. It goes somewhere it wanted to go.
Lightning flickers far below. {Crew} counts the seconds and loses count.
act_camp: {Crew} lights a fire at the edge of the {biome}. Everybody stays up later than they meant to.
The tent goes up crooked. Nobody minds. {Crew} tells a ghost story that isn't scary at all.
{Crew} falls asleep under the sky of {world} and wakes up with frost in {crew.their} hair.

act_camp.text: {Crew} makes something warm in {crew.their} {crew.gear}, and it's the best thing anyone has eaten in weeks.
{Crew}'s {crew.gear} is the only light for kilometres. It's enough.

act_stargaze: {Crew} lies back and counts the moons. Then counts them again, to be sure.
From {world}, the stars are [too many|strange|close|very far]. {Crew} picks one and gives it a name.
{Crew} points out a constellation that looks like a teapot. It definitely does.

act_stargaze.text: {Crew} looks for a long time through {crew.their} {crew.gear}, and says nothing, which says a lot.

act_fish: {Crew} casts a line into the water of {world}. Something nibbles. Something leaves.
{Crew} catches a fish with too many fins and lets it go with an apology.
No fish at all. {Crew} calls it a good day anyway, and means it.
act_sketch: {Crew} draws the {biome} with fast, scratchy lines, then slow careful ones.
{Crew}'s drawing of {place} is better than the real thing, everybody agrees. Except {crew.them}.

act_sketch.text: {Crew} fills three pages of {crew.their} {crew.gear} before the light goes.

act_samples: {Crew} fills one jar with dust, one with air, and one with something that won't stay still.
{Crew} labels every jar carefully. One label just says "???".

act_samples.text: {Crew} chips a sample from the {biome} with {crew.their} {crew.gear}.

act_cook: {Crew} cooks something with a local plant. It tastes like {world} smells.
{Crew} invents a soup. It's blue. It's good. It will never be made the same way again.

act_cook.text: {Crew} eats most of it before anyone else gets a bowl.

act_picnic: The whole crew spreads out on the {biome}. Somebody brought too much bread. Nobody complains.
{Crew} starts a game nobody quite understands, and everybody plays it anyway.
